piece.title: Quartet sketch in D minor (mock)
piece.composer: Mock data, not a real piece

plan.summary: Keep the tune in one clear voice at a time: flute opens it, then hands it to alto sax when it falls below the flute's low D. Clarinet and sax trade the inner harmony, bassoon takes the cello line throughout. Violin II's last two bars only double the viola, so they are left out to keep the texture light under the sax.

assignments.reason: Sits in the flute's singing middle register; carries the opening clearly.
The tune dips to C♯4, under the flute's range; alto sax plays it in its warm middle.
Clarinet blends under the flute and keeps the inner pulse.
Sax holds the viola's thirds until it takes over the tune.
Clarinet picks up the viola harmony when the sax moves to the melody.
Bassoon is the only player with the cello's low register.

dropped.reason: Doubles the viola a third above; with sax on the tune, a fourth line would crowd it.
